finding.statement: Work over C with Q-coefficients at (g,n)=(6,6). Let Y be any closed substack of M_{6,6} and T_Z := ker(T -> W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6} minus Y;Q)(21)) the associated kernel-form term. Exactness of W_{-16} on the Borel-Moore localization sequence makes W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q) -> T have image exactly T_Z, so T_Z is a QUOTIENT of W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q). That source group is pure polarizable of weight -16: H^{BM}_k of any finite-type object is Q-dual to H_c^k, whose weights are at most k, so Borel-Moore weights in degree k are at least -k and the bottom filtration step W_{-k}H^{BM}_k is pure of weight -k with polarizable graded piece. Since pure polarizable weight -16 Q-Hodge structures form a semisimple abelian category, a quotient of a finite direct sum of Q(8) is a finite direct sum of Q(8). Hence, for the ATT-0120 support Y, 'W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8)' is a SUFFICIENT condition for the exact C66-TATE-SUPPORT theorem, and it requires no closed regular embedding, no lci or purity hypothesis, no Gysin map, and no degree shift by twice a codimension -- only Poincare-Verdier duality on the smooth ambient, which FND-0180 already supplies. It remains sufficient, not necessary, and it says nothing about support-exhaustion T_Z = T.
